description: Converts an amount between currencies using a live FX rate: TrueFX for its 10 quoted majors (genuinely live tick data), frankfurter.app daily ECB reference rate as the fallback for every other currency pair (30 total). Edge cases: amount may be zero or negative (converted as given); from and to are ISO 4217 codes; the same currency on both sides returns the amount with source identity; no rate found gives available false and no figure. The rate is a TrueFX tick or a daily ECB reference rate, not what a bank or broker would give you. Not covered: markups, fees and rounding rules of a provider. Use when user asks "what's $X worth in EUR?" or any currency conversion where the rate itself isn't already known. Returns: converted, rate, source (truefx/frankfurter/identity), asOf, available (false + error if no rate could be found for that pair). If available is false, do not use any result field (computed figures and any verdict are null or empty), so read available first.
name: workflow.run_forex_currency_converter_live
title: Forex Currency Converter (Live)
